verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the SDK runs language, speech, and vision models on the device with prompts, audio, and images staying local and working with no network (runanywhere-docs-3, runanywhere-gh-1), and that the CLI runs local models offline without an account (runanywhere-docs-6, runanywhere-docs-14). Hosted execution is an explicit opt-in that is never silently routed (runanywhere-docs-10, runanywhere-docs-35, runanywhere-docs-16), and a hands-on user ran the local rcli demo (runanywhere-comm-4), with the vendor stating no data is collected (runanywhere-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent verification of no telemetry or network egress during local inference, and consistent hands-on success, since some users hit install and runtime failures (runanywhere-comm-3, runanywhere-comm-14) and the MetalRT path requires M3+ hardware (runanywhere-comm-13).
